title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.05608v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920x1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. translated_title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video：同步视频与音频生成的基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，这是一个用于同步文本到音频-视频生成的基础扩散模型家族，包含 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（30亿参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（290亿参数）两款模型。两款模型均可在文本到音频-视频（T2AV）和图像到音频-视频（I2AV）两种模式下生成5秒视频片段，并配有同步的44 kHz音频（包括唇音同步）；内置的超分辨率模型可将输出分辨率提升至全高清（1920x1080）。基于 Kandinsky 5.0 的视频生成能力，Kandinsky 6.0 Video 采用双流 CrossDiT 架构，通过双向交叉注意力连接预训练的视频流与新训练的音频流，实现时间与语义上的对齐。我们的持续预训练策略首先在大规模音频语料库上从头训练音频流，然后在配对的音频-视频数据上联合训练两个流，同时保持单模态能力……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 是一系列用于同步文本到音频-视频生成的基础扩散模型，其核心创新是采用双流 CrossDiT 架构，通过双向交叉注意力实现视频流与音频流的时间和语义对齐，可生成带同步44 kHz音频（含唇音同步）的5秒全高清视频。
en_tdlr: Kandinsky 6.0 Video is a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation whose key innovation is a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that aligns pretrained video and newly trained audio streams via bidirectional cross-attention, producing 5-second Full-HD videos with synchronized 44 kHz audio including lip-sync.
